case_title: ABDUL WAHEED v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH
aggravating_circumstances: Enmity, use of gun, multiple deaths
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Affirmed conviction and partly allowed appeal
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were involved in a civil dispute over construction on a site. The accused, along with others, were armed with guns, lathis, and dandas. During an altercation, the accused opened fire, resulting in the death of the victim. The victim sustained gunshot injuries to his arm and later died due to shock and hemorrhage from the injuries. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and a dying declaration to establish the guilt of the accused. The trial court convicted the accused of murder, and the High Court affirmed the conviction. The accused were also charged with causing hurt and participating in an unlawful assembly.
